contracts.source: MLB 40-man roster plus source-tracked contract imports
contracts.note: WAR is full player-season production across all clubs. Salary basis distinguishes full-season, estimated and team payroll amounts; do not treat these as equivalent. Imported players outside the roster remain visible. USD only. No salary-based WAR expectation is inferred.

validation.note: Rolling prior-three-year 5:3:1 benchmark, evaluated only on completed calendar years with an observed target-year MLB WAR record. Missing seasons are omitted. This excludes players with no target-year MLB record (survivorship bias), uses retrospectively revised source data, and is not an independent archived forecast test. MAE is typical absolute error, not a confidence interval. No salary-based expectation is inferred.
